items: Thanks for their partnership in the Good News

Hard pressed between life and death

He will soon be set free from prison
He was chosen before the other apostles

items: Make my joy full by being of one mind
Every tongue confesses Jesus Christ is Lord
Poured out on the sacrifice of their faith

options: The name which is above every name

options: That he didn't run or labor in vain
That he suffered more than others
That he kept the law blamelessly

questions.answer: each counting others better than himself
wrong: each serving the other in love
each seeking the good of all

wrong: for the glory of his name

I press on toward the goal

options: Studied the law day and night
